memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Gout
- Status: First presentation, asymptomatic between flares, reports one flare in last month affecting left big toe, resolved with NSAID.
- Plan: Start allopurinol 100 mg OD after breakfast; advise low‑purine diet, increase water intake.
- Weight: 68 kg; Waist: 84 cm (female cutoff 80 cm – central obesity).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – whole grain toast, egg white, fruit; Lunch – vegetable dal, brown rice, lean fish; Dinner – soup, salad, chapati.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-07-05.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum uric acid 7.2 mg/dL (ref 2.4‑6.0); Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (ref 0.5‑1.1)

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Gout
- Status: On allopurinol 100 mg OD for 3 months, no flares, reports mild heel discomfort after prolonged standing.
- Plan: Increase allopurinol to 200 mg OD after breakfast; continue lifestyle measures; re‑check labs in 6 weeks.
- Weight: 67 kg; Waist: 82 cm (still >80 cm).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – oats with milk, nuts; Lunch – mixed vegetable curry, quinoa; Dinner – lentil soup, steamed veggies, roti.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-10-10.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum uric acid 5.8 mg/dL (ref 2.4‑6.0); Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Gout
- Status: Acute flare of right first metatarsophalangeal joint, painful, swollen, started 2 days ago.
- Plan: Prescribe colchicine 0.5 mg BD for 5 days; continue allopurinol 200 mg OD; advise rest, ice, elevate foot.
- Weight: 66.5 kg; Waist: 81 cm.
- Diet advice: Breakfast – idli with sambar, no coconut chutney; Lunch – vegetable khichdi, curd; Dinner – clear vegetable soup, steamed fish, chapati.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2026-01-02.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Dear Clinic, the gout flare in my right toe has settled after the colchicine course. No pain or swelling today. Thank you.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Gout
- Status: No flares for 3 months on allopurinol 200 mg OD, but mild gastritis symptoms noted after meals.
- Plan: Stop allopurinol; start febuxostat 40 mg OD before breakfast; monitor liver enzymes and uric acid in 6 weeks; continue lifestyle advice.
- Weight: 66 kg; Waist: 80 cm (at cutoff).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – poha with peanuts, tea; Lunch – brown rice, sambar, steamed veggies; Dinner – vegetable stew, roti.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2026-04-15.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum uric acid 4.6 mg/dL (ref 2.4‑6.0); Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; ALT 22 U/L (ref ≤35); AST 20 U/L (ref ≤40)

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-07-10 09:30 with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) for gout follow‑up.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Gout
- Status: On febuxostat 40 mg OD for 6 months, no flares, uric acid well controlled.
- Plan: Continue febuxostat; repeat labs in 3 months; reinforce low‑purine diet and weight maintenance.
- Weight: 65.5 kg; Waist: 79 cm (<80 cm).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – multigrain toast, avocado, boiled egg; Lunch – mixed vegetable dal, millet; Dinner – grilled chicken, salad, chapati.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2026-10-10.
